title: MFA not enforced for all privileged accounts
description: Management reports that a subset of privileged administrator accounts does not enforce MFA; population and exception paths remain to be validated.

title: Privileged-access reviews are inconsistent
description: Periodic access certification is incomplete across business units.

title: Critical legacy ERP uses unsupported technology
description: The core ERP version is reported outside standard vendor support; exposure and extended-support arrangements require validation.

title: Security patching exceeds target timelines
description: A sample of critical server patches exceeded the synthetic policy target; exploitability and the complete overdue population are unconfirmed.

title: Logging coverage is incomplete
description: Several critical systems are reported not to forward complete security logs; alert coverage and alternative telemetry require testing.

title: Incident-response exercises are overdue
description: No enterprise simulation evidence was provided for the illustrative review period; this does not by itself establish ineffective incident response.

title: Sensitive customer information is not consistently encrypted
description: Management reports inconsistent encryption across databases holding synthetic customer data; data elements jurisdictions and compensating controls remain unverified.

title: Data-retention rules are inconsistently implemented
description: Retention schedules are not technically enforced in several repositories.

title: Critical-vendor assessments are incomplete
description: Security assessments are missing or stale for multiple vendors designated critical; contract rights concentration and known issues require review.

title: Cybersecurity accountabilities are unclear
description: Business and technology security responsibilities are not consistently documented.

title: Risk exceptions lack expiry dates
description: Several accepted cyber exceptions have no approval expiry or review trigger.

title: Secure development controls are inconsistent
description: Development teams use inconsistent code review and security testing gates.

title: Disaster recovery testing is incomplete
description: Recovery evidence supplied does not demonstrate end-to-end recovery for several critical applications; achievable recovery objectives remain unconfirmed.

title: Cloud configuration baseline coverage is partial
description: Automated configuration monitoring does not cover all cloud subscriptions.
